results.title: People Watching
results.overview: The visuals for Sam Fender's single 'People Watching'.

results.title: Serpent Beauty
results.overview: Anna is a young girl with a mysterious destiny, born with the bloodline of an ancient serpent king—half human, half snake.

results.title: aespa: Amazon Music Live
results.overview: Popular K-pop group aespa headlined one of the highlights of Amazon Music Live Season 4 in Los Angeles. They performed some of their biggest hits live, including iconic songs like "Supernova" and "Next Level", as well as an English-language performance of "Rich Man".

results.title: Blondi
results.overview: Can a dog still be man’s best friend if that man is the Führer? Blondi explores the bizarre bond between Hitler and his beloved German Shepherd. From eating the crumbs under the table at the Führer’s birthday, to living in the confinement of the bunker, this film presents intimate glimpses of the dog’s daily life intertwined with the realities of war, depicting the oblivious pet's surreal impact on the Reich.

results.title: Identity
results.overview: A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime

results.title: Break Even
results.overview: A gambler finds creative ways to put everything on the line in hopes that he breaks even.

results.title: Short Sharp Shocks Volume 4
results.overview: It's back! A fourth compelling collection of SHORT SHARP SHOCKS revisits the heyday of the supporting program with a compendium of eerie and eccentric British short films presented for the first time in High Definition. Well-known names to spot include Patrick Macnee, John Le Mesurier, Gabrielle Drake and Elspeth Gray. Settle in for a strange cinematic journey through uncanny stories, twists in the tale, low-budget weirdness and oodles of atmosphere.

results.title: Waltzing with Brando
results.overview: The story of how Marlon Brando plucked Bernard Judge, an obscure but idealistic Los Angeles architect from his stable existence and convinced him that he should build the world’s first ecologically perfect retreat on a tiny and uninhabitable Tahitian island.

results.title: FRI(G)IDA
results.overview: The peace of a widowed grandmother is interrupted when a mysterious package arrives at the apartment where she lives and is opened by her son, who is frightened by what he sees and initiates a family crisis with the two women of the house.

results.title: Get-Together-ers
results.overview: Phil sabotages an intimate holiday gathering when he attempts to gift his childhood friend's fiancé something special.

results.title: Fractured
results.overview: Based on true events, this film with follow the journey of a young woman traversing her trauma, heartbreak and mental illness while pushing the boundaries of reality to overcome it all and find herself.

results.title: Aloe Blacc @ Baloise Session 2025
results.original_title: Aloe Blacc - Live at Baloise Session 2025
results.overview: For Aloe Blacc, a song is more than just a track. Both a producer and performer, he combines funk, soul and political engagement in songs such as ‘I Need a Dollar’ and ‘The Man’. He is a musician who has mastered groove and the art of making bodies and minds dance.

results.title: Pandora's Box
results.overview: Pandora has just moved to the new apartment. Everything was marvellous until she found out a horrible truth about her friend and herself.

results.title: Gondhal
results.overview: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

results.title: Cold?
results.overview: A man in his forties, afflicted with amnesia, crosses paths with a woman who was once his first love. Though no memories of her resurface, he is carried away by a feeling that runs deeper than the boundaries of his memory.
